description: This file defines the 'TestMultiSegmentBufferWriter' class, which implements buffer writing interfaces for testing multi-segment buffer handling in serialization. It manages multiple byte arrays, allowing advancement and buffer retrieval with size hints, and provides methods to view the committed and current buffers as read-only sequences.

classes.name: TestMultiSegmentBufferWriter
classes.description: A buffer writer class implementing IBufferWriter<byte> and IOutputBuffer, managing multiple byte segments for testing serialization buffering.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the write position by a specified number of bytes, adding the current buffer to the committed list.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Provides a Memory<byte> buffer with at least the requested size, resizing the internal buffer if necessary.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Provides a Span<byte> buffer with at least the requested size, resizing the internal buffer if necessary.

methods.name: GetReadOnlySequence
methods.description: Returns a ReadOnlySequence<byte> representing all committed buffers, batched by max segment size.

methods.name: PeekAllBuffers
methods.description: Returns a ReadOnlySequence<byte> over all committed buffers and the current buffer.
